name: list_stories
description: List the storyteller's evening stories (curated and tutor-written) in the village's language, in the rotation's order: their levels, chapters, pictures and words, the story each continues, what the learner has heard of each (told: how many times to the end; chapter: chapters heard of a telling under way; levels: evenings heard at each level), their level, whether all are heard, those left at their level, and the vignette library the pictures are made of.
